cases.utterance: how many employees are in each department?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY headcount DESC

cases.utterance: what is the total account balance broken down by account type?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT account_type, SUM(balance) AS total_balance FROM accounts GROUP BY account_type ORDER BY total_balance DESC

cases.utterance: how many employees hold each job title?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS count FROM employees GROUP BY title ORDER BY count DESC

cases.utterance: what is the average account balance across all accounts?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM accounts

cases.utterance: which acquisition sources brought in the most users?

cases.utterance: what is the breakdown of users by device type?
